messages:
Maria Chen: Quick heads-up - the sample-app streaming e2e is flaky. Observed out-of-order / duplicated final tokens when auth refresh happens mid-stream.
AJ: Repro steps? which SDK (node/python/browser)? :eyes: 
Maria Chen: Node SDK (v0.12.3) in the sample app. Steps:
  1) start a long SSE stream from the hosted API
  2) set short-lived token so refresh runs ~10s in
  3) client does auth-refresh -> we see a 401 then reconnect
  4) client logs show chunks arriving with fragments merged incorrectly and last chunk duplicated
AJ: Ugh. Any logs/snippets?
Maria Chen: Client log (trimmed):
EVENT: data: : {"type":"delta","text":"Hel"
EVENT: data: : {"type":"delta","text":"lo"}
--- auth refresh triggered ---
EVENT: data: : {"type":"delta","text":" world"}
EVENT: data: : [DONE]
You can see the "Hel"/"lo" split then a reconnect that sends " world" separately - client ends up assembling "Hello worldworld" in some runs.
Rachel L: I suspect the JS SDK parser merges on newline boundaries and our reconnect path doesn't re-sync Last-Event-ID, so fragments get replayed. Python SDK trims/handles differently.
Samir Patel: Also check that auth refresh flow doesn't resend the same pending fragment. If the SDK retries the HTTP without de-dupe on the server, fragments double-play.
Maria Chen: Server logs show the second connection got a partial continuation and the runtime emitted the same last token twice (race between KV cache flush and reconnection).
AJ: Short-term workaround for the sample app: buffer until full event delimiter and dedupe duplicate final tokens on client side. We should push a patch to node-sdk sample.
Rachel L: I'll open a draft PR that: 1) holds partial fragments until a full JSON message is parsed, 2) uses Last-Event-ID header to prefer newer streams. PR #4321 (draft).
Samir Patel: For infra/runtime: make reconnect include an idempotency or sequence number in SSE events to make clients robust. Adding a small seq field helps ordering guarantees.
infra-bot: deploy/log: runtime patch candidate deployed to canary at 2026-03-21T14:42:01Z (build bld-2026-03-21-7).
AJ: DX note: onboarding docs for streaming apps don't mention auth-refresh pitfalls or recommend pre-warming tokens for long streams. Add a snippet for pre-signed URLs or refresh hooks.
Maria Chen: Also parity gap: python-sdk auto JSON boundary detection and drops malformed fragments, node-sdk emitted them as events. Need parity tests in CI.
Rachel L: I'll add e2e that simulates token expiry mid-stream and asserts no duplicated final tokens.
Samir Patel: Open question: runtime-level guarantees vs seq ids + client de-dupe. Tradeoffs: perf vs complexity.
AJ: Pragmatic route: seq ids in events + client de-dupe; provide stricter mode later.
Maria Chen: I'll create an epic linking the PR, doc update, and e2e. Will post reproduction script and sample-app branch when ready.
AJ: Thanks :thumbsup: 
Rachel L: Tip: locally set STREAM_TOKEN_TTL=30 to force mid-stream refresh.
Maria Chen: Will ping when PR is ready. :rocket:
